# teams_online_voicemail_validation_configuration (Data Source)

Look up an existing OnlineVoicemailValidationConfiguration object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `audio_file_validation_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -AudioFileValidationEnabled parameter.
- `audio_file_validation_uri` (String) Maps to the -AudioFileValidationUri parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
